info.title: ReqAI Enterprise API
info.description: Versioned asynchronous job and artifact API. Large content is represented by artifact references.

get.summary: Discover the authenticated API and enabled capabilities

200.description: Tenant-scoped API capability and safe prompt-release metadata

post.description: Materials must be nonempty UTF-8 TXT, Markdown or JSON; unsupported MIME returns 415 and malformed, binary or empty content returns 400. Inline businessContext is limited to the JSON request limit. Upload larger inputs through POST /api/v1/artifacts and provide inputArtifactId (mutually exclusive with businessContext). Optional baselineArtifactId and referenceArtifactIds attach comparison and reference materials. Set promptVersion to 2.17.0 for current source coverage rules; when omitted, the configured active version is used. Discover available models and prompt releases through GET /api/v1.

get.description: Download the stored result in its original content type (raw, the default), or render a babok-requirements.v1 result as the full BABOK Markdown report. A babok-text-draft.v1 fallback exposes preserved model responses as Markdown; it is not an editable requirements registry. Result metadata is available separately at /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/result.

criticEnabled.description: Run the independent AI review supported by the selected prompt profile.

indexingPending.description: Returned with grouped history while older authorized jobs still require metadata backfill.

executionSummary.description: Observed stages from the entire authorized snapshot, independent of the timeline cursor

attempts.description: Most recent identifiable model calls in time order

ReviewMetadata.description: Additive review metadata, maximum serialized UTF-8 size 256 KiB. Omitted compatible fields inherit from the authorized base. New unknown fields are rejected; unchanged inherited extensions are preserved. Actor, time, fingerprints and source/research lineage are server-authoritative. Content changes invalidate previous completeness and issue acknowledgment.

closureKind.description: Resolved requires current confirmations; dismissed records an explicit reason.

gapRequirements.description: Per-GAP confirmations. Every linked requirement must be explicitly incorporated or marked no-change with a reason before resolved closure.

completeness.description: Send check:true to record a new manual check; checked/stale/contentHash/actor/time are authoritative output.

acknowledgment.description: Send confirm:true after reviewing the current open issue list. New-client finalization with open issues requires a current acknowledgment. It is not semantic approval.

proposals.description: Stable insight-id:index keys. Values retain operation add/replace, targetType/targetId, originalText, before/after and decision accepted/rejected; reversal is retain-manual or restore-before. Exact new records, replacement snapshots and original wording are validated against authorized lineage; unchanged historical evidence survives later manual edits.

citationChecks.description: Stable insight-id:citation-index keys. The server resolves the original citation and rejects checked:true for unsafe/non-HTTP(S) URLs. No external request occurs.

discussionProposals.description: Local acceptance or rejection receipts for contextual AI proposal packages. The server stamps actor and time when persisted.

baseVersionId.description: Required when creating a new discussion; the version must belong to the task.
Saved requirements version used as the proposal basis.

draft.description: Optional current unsaved registry and review decisions; validated server-side.

expectedLatestVersionId.description: Optional concurrency precondition; null requires no previous version.

clientMutationId.description: Stable identity for retrying exactly the same save payload.

registry.description: Canonical BABOK registry validated by the versioned babok-requirements.v1 server contract.
